capabilities: Split multi-link property values into separate real links
Make frontmatter links clickable in Source mode, Live Preview and Reading
Count frontmatter links as backlinks on their targets
Support paths with spaces, embeds, and external links
Delegate rename handling to Advanced Rename and Delete Handler
disambiguation: Not a link repair tool; it makes existing frontmatter links work without rewriting note text.
extras: Documentation doubles as a demo vault shipped with every release and viewable on GitHub; beta versions installable via BRAT; since 3.0.0 rename handling was moved to a separate plugin, offered as a one-time install.
intentEvidence: Obsidian treats a property whose whole value is one link, [[wikilink]] or [text](note.md), as a real link.
motivation: Multi-link frontmatter values was a feature long-requested on the Obsidian forum.
problem: Obsidian treats a property value containing several links as one broken link that neither resolves, opens, nor counts as a backlink, and frontmatter links are not clickable in Source mode.

relations.evidence: rename and delete handling belongs to Advanced Rename and Delete Handler instead
Complementary repair: makes existing links work without rewriting note text
Broader link support: splits multi-link values; resolves each target and counts backlinks

summary: Plugin that turns links inside frontmatter property values into real, individually resolved links that are clickable and count as backlinks.
